name: - UFDao
fix_description: The publicOffer.rate parameter is set incorrectly, allowing users to mint LP tokens at a price far below market value. Fix by setting rate to match current market price, or add a price oracle check to ensure the offer price is within a reasonable range of the LP market value.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct two-step abuse of protocol logic: buy through the public offer, then burn UFT to redeem USDC, repeated with an inflated amount. It involves no flash loans, no complex routing, and minimal cross-contract reasoning beyond understanding a straightforward mint/burn imbalance.
